question: Where is café positioned within 110 kilometers when moving from Smithfield Community Park, Smithfield, NC toward Wakemed Heart Center, Raleigh, NC?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.32926 35.528601)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.589136 35.784654)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.32926 35.528601)',4326)::geography, 110000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.32926 35.528601)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.description: Casual, health-conscious chain cafe featuring custom smoothies, sandwiches & wraps.
